title: CAT 2024 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quant - Ratios and Proportions
subject: Quant

questions.q: A fruit seller has a total of 187 fruits consisting of apples, mangoes and oranges. The number of apples and mangoes are in the ratio $5:2$. After she sells 75 apples, 26 mangoes and half of the oranges, the ratio of the number of unsold apples to the number of unsold oranges becomes $3:2$. The total number of unsold fruits is
questions.explain: Let apples be $5x$, mangoes be $2x$. Oranges $= 187 - 7x$. Remaining apples $= 5x - 75$. Remaining mangoes $= 2x - 26$. Remaining oranges $= (187 - 7x)/2$. We are given $(5x - 75) / ((187 - 7x)/2) = 3/2 \implies 2(5x - 75) / (187 - 7x) = 3/2 \implies 4(5x - 75) = 3(187 - 7x) \implies 20x - 300 = 561 - 21x \implies 41x = 861 \implies x = 21$. Initial apples $= 105$, mangoes $= 42$, oranges $= 187 - 147 = 40$. Unsold apples $= 105 - 75 = 30$. Unsold mangoes $= 42 - 26 = 16$. Unsold oranges $= 40/2 = 20$. Total unsold $= 30 + 16 + 20 = 66$.
